Dense_RAG.description: Standard dense embedding retrieval using FAISS without fusion, reranking, verification, or self-correction

Hybrid_RAG.description: Hybrid BM25 + FAISS with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) and Cross-Encoder reranking, without verification or self-correction

CRAG_Baseline.description: Local Corrective RAG implementation with heuristic retrieval evaluator and rewrite fallback, without NLI or cross-document conflict preservation

Veritas_AI.description: Full Veritas AI system: Hybrid RRF + Cross-Encoder + NLI Evidence Assessment + Diagnostic Reformulation + Self-Correction Loop

Ablation_No_Hybrid.description: Evaluates the contribution of BM25 lexical fusion by disabling BM25 and RRF (Dense only + Veritas correction)
Ablation_No_Hybrid.research_question: How much does lexical retrieval aid in overcoming vocabulary mismatch and sparse keyword gaps?

Ablation_No_Reranker.description: Evaluates Cross-Encoder reranking contribution by passing raw RRF top-k directly to evidence assessment
Ablation_No_Reranker.research_question: Does cross-encoder reranking improve retrieval precision and initial evidence sufficiency before correction?

Ablation_No_NLI.description: Replaces DeBERTa NLI with surface token overlap heuristics for contradiction and consistency checking
Ablation_No_NLI.research_question: Is formal NLI necessary for detecting fine-grained semantic contradictions across multi-document sources?

Ablation_No_Diagnostic_Reformulation.description: Replaces failure-mode-specific reformulation with naive generic query repetition / broadening
Ablation_No_Diagnostic_Reformulation.research_question: Does diagnosing the specific failure mode (Coverage Gap vs Divergence vs Conflict) outperform naive query rewriting?

Ablation_No_Self_Correction.description: Single-pass Veritas AI: performs hybrid search, reranking, and verification, but emits output without corrective re-retrieval
Ablation_No_Self_Correction.research_question: What is the net gain in answer reliability, recovery rate, and groundedness directly attributable to the closed corrective loop?

Ablation_Max_Retries_0.description: Budget variation with maximum retry count = 0
Ablation_Max_Retries_0.research_question: Zero-retry baseline for loop latency and accuracy trade-off

Ablation_Max_Retries_1.description: Budget variation with maximum retry count = 1

Ablation_Max_Retries_3.description: Budget variation with maximum retry count = 3
Ablation_Max_Retries_3.research_question: Diminishing returns and latency impact of extended retry budgets
